causal_status.best_current_explanation: Discoverability differs at the entity-linkage and retrieval layers, not at simple site existence. B03 has a distinctive branch identity, current structured place entry, precise unit data, and repeated web mentions. B01 preserves a name in an aggregate city list but loses the storefront-address link. B02 combines a generic descriptor with a highly polysemous sign string, producing collision-heavy retrieval and no qualifying text or structured site match.
live_alternatives: The B01/B02 businesses never generated durable text or structured records.
Records were generated but were later removed or not preserved.
Records survive but are not indexed or ranked inside the frozen queries and budgets.
The observed sign strings are not the canonical business identifiers used in surviving records.
Current operation, franchise infrastructure, and marketing footprint are confounded and cannot be separated with this calibration case.

claim_boundary: This three-bay, selected hard-case calibration cannot estimate prevalence, query difficulty, platform effects, franchise effects, or causal mechanisms.
